safi-cedvel:1-3.t:
* I'rab:
(أيّها) a vocative, a specified indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative. (النبي) a badal (substitute) for (أيّ) – or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) – following it in the nominative in form. (الفاء) links to the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (لعدتهنّ) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object pronoun in (طلقوهنّ), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: "facing the beginning of their ʿidda". (الواو) is a conjunction in the three places. (ربّكم) an adjective of the name of Majesty (Allah), accusative. (لا) prohibitive and jussive-governing. (من بيوتهنّ) attached to (تخرجوهنّ). (لا) like the first. (يخرجن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of jussive. (إلّا) for exception. (يأتين) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative. (بفاحشة) attached to (يأتين).
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يأتين..) is in the position of genitive by an omitted preposition, attached to a ḥāl, i.e. "except as sinners by their committing the indecency" [Note: This ḥāl is an exception from the totality of states, i.e. "let them not go out in any state whatsoever except in the state of their being sinners ..."].
(الواو) resumptive; the demonstrative in (تلك) refers to the preceding rulings. (الواو) conjunction. (من) a conditional noun in the position of nominative, a mubtadaʾ (subject). (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (قد) a particle of certainty. (لا) negative; the fāʿil (agent) of (تدري) is a pronoun, its implied form being "أنت" (you), and the address is to the one who divorces. (بعد) an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يحدث).
Clause: «النداء ... » (the vocative) has no grammatical position; it is an initial clause.
And the clause: «الشرط وفعله وجوابه ... » (the condition, its verb and its apodosis) has no grammatical position; it is the response to the vocative [Note: There are many opinions about the vocative addressed to the Prophet; see the tafsīr works for them. It is also permissible for the clause of the condition, its verb and its apodosis to be in the position of accusative as the content of speech (maqūl al-qawl) of an implied "say", i.e. "O Prophet, say to your community ..."].
And the clause: «طلّقتم ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «طلّقوهنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition.
And the clause: «أحصوا العدّة» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.
And the clause: «اتّقوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the apodosis.
And the clause: «لا تخرجوهنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption (istinʾāf bayānī).
And the clause: «لا يخرجن ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «يأتين ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «تلك حدود ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «من يتعدّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause «تلك حدود».
And the clause: «يتعدّ ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible that the khabar be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together].
And the clause: «قد ظلم نفسه ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «لا تدري ... » has no grammatical position; it is a causal clause.
And the clause: «لعلّ اللَّه يحدث ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption [Note: The object of تدري is implied. As for the one who takes (لعل) as suspending the verb, the clause is in the position of accusative, standing in the place of the two objects of تدري].
And the clause: «يحدث ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of لعلّ.
2- (الفاء) resumptive, and the second links to the apodosis. (بمعروف) attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of أمسكوهنّ, and the second is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of فارقوهنّ. (منكم) attached to a ḥāl from (ذوي) – or to an adjective of it. (للَّه) attached to (أقيموا) with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "for the sake of Allah". The demonstrative in (ذلكم) refers to what has been mentioned, from the beginning of the sūra up to here, of rulings. (به) attached to (يوعظ). (من) a relative in the position of nominative, nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). (باللَّه) attached to (يؤمن). (الواو) resumptive. (من يتّق اللَّه) like «من يتعدّ حدود». (له) attached to an omitted second object (mafʿūl bihi).
And the clause: «بلغن ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «أمسكوهنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive-governing condition.
And the clause: «فارقوهنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أمسكوهنّ.
And the clause: «أشهدوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أمسكوهن.
And the clause: «أقيموا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أمسكوهن.
And the clause: «ذلكم يوعظ به ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «يوعظ به من كان ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم).
And the clause: «كان يؤمن باللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (من); and the clause: «يؤمن باللَّه ... » is in the position of accusative, the khabar of كان.
And the clause: «من يتّق ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «يتّق ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) (1).
And the clause: «يجعل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis, not accompanied by the fāʾ.
3- (الواو) is a conjunction in both places. (حيث) a noun indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (يرزقه). (لا) negative. (على اللَّه) attached to (يتوكّل). (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (قد) a particle of certainty. (لكلّ) attached to an omitted second object [Note: or attached to a ḥāl from (قدرا), if جعل is taken to include the meaning of "create"].
And the clause: «يرزقه ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause يجعل ...
And the clause: «لا يحتسب ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «من يتوكّل ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause من يتّق اللَّه ...
And the clause: «يتوكّل على اللَّه ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) (3).
And the clause: «هو حسبه ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «إنّ اللَّه بالغ ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «جعل اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is a causal clause.

* Morphology:
(1) يتعدّ: it contains an iʿlāl by deletion, to suit the jussive; its wazn is يتفعّ.
(2) مخرجا: a mīmī maṣdar (verbal noun with initial mīm) from the triliteral خرج; its wazn is مفعل with fatḥa on the mīm and the ʿayn; it may also be a noun of place.

* Benefits:
Iltifāt (grammatical shift of person): in the saying of the Exalted لا تَدْرِي لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يُحْدِثُ بَعْدَ ذلِكَ أَمْراً.
A shift from the third person to the second in the saying of the Exalted: لا تَدْرِي. The address in «لا تدري» is to the transgressor, by way of iltifāt, for greater emphasis on deterring from transgression, and not to the Prophet ﷺ as has been said. The meaning is: whoever transgresses the limits of Allah the Exalted has exposed himself to harm, for you do not know, O transgressor, the outcome of the matter.

safi-cedvel:4-7.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (من المحيض) attached to (يئسن). (من نسائكم) attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of يئسن. (ارتبتم) a past verb in the position of jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (الواو) conjunction. (اللائي) a relative in the position of nominative, conjoined to the first relative [Note: It is permissible that the relative be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, indicated by the first khabar; the conjunction is then a conjunction of clauses]. (يحضن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of jussive. (أجلهنّ) a second mubtadaʾ, nominative. (أن) a maṣdar particle governing the accusative. (يضعن) in the position of accusative by أن. (الواو) resumptive. (من يتّق اللَّه يجعل له) its i'rab has already been given [Note: in verse (2) of this sūra]. (من أمره) attached to a ḥāl from (يسرا), which is the first object.
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضعن..) is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ, i.e.: their term is the delivery of their burden.
Clause: «اللائي يئسن ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «يئسن ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (اللائي).
And the clause: «إن ارتبتم ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (اللائي); and the clause: «عدّتهنّ ثلاثة أشهر ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «لم يحضن ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second relative (اللائي).
And the clause: «أولات الأحمال ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the resumptive clause; and the clause: «أجلهن أن يضعن ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ أولات ...
And the clause: «يضعن ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «من يتّق اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «يتق اللَّه ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible that the khabar be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together].
And the clause: «يجعل ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis, not accompanied by the fāʾ.
5- The demonstrative in (ذلك) refers to the preceding rulings. (إليكم) attached to (أنزله). (الواو) conjunction. (من يتق اللَّه يكفّر) the i'rab of its like has already been given [Note: in verse (2) of this sūra]. (عنه) attached to (يكفّر), by its inclusion of the meaning "sends down". (يعظم) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to (يكفّر) by the wāw. (له) attached to (يعظم).
And the clause: «ذلك أمر اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «أنزله إليكم ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl from أمر اللَّه, the operator in it being the demonstrative.
And the clause: «من يتّق اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause ذلك أمر اللَّه.
And the clause: «يتّق اللَّه ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible that the khabar be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis].
And the clause: «يكفّر ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis, not accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «يعظم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause يكفّر.
6- (حيث) an adverbial noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of genitive, attached to (أسكنوهنّ) [Note: (من) is partitive – or for the beginning of the range]. (من وجدكم) a badal from حيث with repetition of the preposition. (الواو) conjunction. (لا) prohibitive and jussive-governing. (اللام) the lām of reason. (تضيّقوا) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām. (عليهنّ) attached to (تضيّقوا).. The interpreted maṣdar (أن تضيّقوا) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (تضارّوهنّ).
(الواو) conjunction. (كنّ) a defective past verb (kāna) in the position of jussive, the protasis. (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (عليهنّ) the second, attached to (أنفقوا). (حتّى) a particle of limit and of genitive. (يضعن) an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative by an implied أن after حتّى..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يضعن) is in the position of genitive by (حتّى), attached to (أنفقوا).
(الفاء) conjunction. (أرضعن) a past verb in the position of jussive, the protasis. (لكم) attached to (أرضعن); the object of the suckling is omitted, i.e. "your children". (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (أجورهنّ) a second object, accusative. (بينكم) an adverb, accusative, attached to (ائتمروا). (بمعروف) attached to a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ائتمروا. (إن تعاسرتم) like إن أرضعن. (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (السين) a particle of futurity. (له) attached to (سترضع)..
And the clause: «أسكنوهنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «سكنتم ... » is in the position of genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «لا تضارّوهنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أسكنوهنّ.
And the clause: «تضيّقوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «إن كنّ أولات ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أسكنوهنّ [Note: or it is resumptive].
And the clause: «أنفقوا ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «يضعن ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «إن أرضعن ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إن كنّ..
And the clause: «آتوهنّ ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «ائتمروا ... » is in the position of jussive, conjoined to the clause آتوهنّ.
And the clause: «إن تعاسرتم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause إن أرضعن ...
And the clause: «سترضع له أخرى» is in the position of jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
7- (اللام) the lām of command. (من سعته) attached to (ينفق). (الواو) conjunction. (من) a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative, a mubtadaʾ. (عليه) attached to (قدر). (الفاء) links to the apodosis. (اللام) the lām of command. (ممّا) attached to (ينفق). (لا) negative. (إلّا) for restriction. (ما) a relative in the position of accusative, a second object, the returning pronoun (ʿāʾid) being omitted, i.e. "ātāhu iyyāh". (بعد) an adverb, accusative, attached to an omitted second object.
And the clause: «ينفق ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «من قدر عليه رزقه» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause ينفق.
And the clause: «قدر عليه رزقه ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible that the khabar be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis].
And the clause: «ينفق ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis, accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «آتاه اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
And the clause: «لا يكلّف اللَّه نفسا ... » has no grammatical position; it is a causal clause.
And the clause: «آتاها ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second relative (ما).
And the clause: «سيجعل اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(4) أولات: feminine of: أولو – and أولي – and see verse (179) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(6) وجدكم: a maṣdar of وجد fī al-māl in the sense of "became wealthy"; its wazn is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn, and the fāʾ may also take fatḥa or kasra.

* Benefits:
The ʿidda of the divorced woman and its rulings.
The woman observing a revocable ʿidda is entitled to maintenance and lodging from the husband for as long as she is in the ʿidda. As for the woman observing an irrevocable (bāʾin) ʿidda, by khulʿ, by the triple divorce, or by liʿān, she is entitled to lodging, whether pregnant or not pregnant, according to most scholars. Ibn ʿAbbās said: she has no lodging unless she is pregnant; and Ibn ʿAbbās, al-Ḥasan, al-Shaʿbī and al-Shāfiʿī said: she has no maintenance unless she is pregnant, which is the apparent meaning of the noble verse. [Translator's note: Ibn ʿAbbās appears twice in the source, with two different opinions, and "al-Ḥasan al-Shaʿbī" is written as one name; translated as written.] As for the woman observing an ʿidda after intercourse by mistake (shubha), or whose marriage has been annulled for a defect or by option on emancipation, she has neither lodging nor maintenance even if she is pregnant. As for the woman observing an ʿidda for the death of her husband, she has no maintenance according to most scholars; as for lodging, there are two opinions. The first: she has no lodging, and this is one of the two opinions of al-Shāfiʿī and of Ibn ʿAbbās, ʿĀʾisha, ʿAṭāʾ, al-Ḥasan and Abū Ḥanīfa. The second: she has lodging, and this is the opinion of ʿUmar, ʿUthmān, Ibn Masʿūd, Ibn ʿUmar, Mālik, al-Thawrī, Aḥmad and Isḥāq. Know that divorce during menstruation and postpartum bleeding is an innovation (bidʿa), as is divorce in a period of purity in which he had intercourse with her. The sunna divorce is that he divorces her in a period of purity in which he has not had intercourse with her. This applies to a woman whose ʿidda is by menstrual periods (aqrāʾ). But if he divorces a woman with whom the marriage was not consummated during menstruation, or a young girl who has not yet menstruated, or a woman past menstruation after having had intercourse with her, or divorces a pregnant woman after having had intercourse with her, or divorces a woman who has not seen blood, there is no blame in that; and as for khulʿ during menstruation or in a period of purity in which he had intercourse with her, there is likewise no blame in it.
Divorce is the last measure to which the husband resorts, after all attempts at reconciliation have failed.
On the authority of Ibn ʿUmar, who said: the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The most hateful of lawful things to Allah is divorce."
And on the authority of Thawbān that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "Any woman who asks her husband for divorce without a pressing reason, the scent of Paradise is forbidden to her."
- The jussive-governing lām (the lām of command)..
It is the lām set for requesting, and its vowel is kasra; making it sākin after the fāʾ and the wāw is more frequent than vowelling it, as in the saying of the Exalted: (فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا لِي وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا بِي); and it may be made sākin after ثمّ: (ثُمَّ لْيَقْضُوا تَفَثَهُمْ). There is no difference, in the lām of request requiring the jussive, between the request being a command, as in the saying of the Exalted: (لِيُنْفِقْ ذُو سَعَةٍ), or a supplication: (لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنا رَبُّكَ), or a plea, as when you say to one who is your equal "let so-and-so do such-and-such", if you do not intend to assert superiority over him. Likewise if it is turned from request to something else, as the one by which it and its accompanying verb are meant as a statement, as in the saying of the Exalted: (مَنْ كانَ فِي الضَّلالَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ الرَّحْمنُ مَدًّا), i.e. "so the Merciful extends (fa-yamudd)"; or a threat: (وَمَنْ شاءَ فَلْيَكْفُرْ). As for the saying of the Exalted: (لِيَكْفُرُوا بِما آتَيْناهُمْ وَلِيَتَمَتَّعُوا), both lāms may be the lām of reason, in which case what follows them is accusative, or the lām of threat, in which case it is jussive. The entry of the lām upon a verb of the first person (speaker) is rare, as in the saying of the Prophet, peace be upon him: (قوموا فلأصل لكم), and the saying of the Exalted: وَقالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا اتَّبِعُوا سَبِيلَنا وَلْنَحْمِلْ خَطاياكُمْ. The lām may be deleted in poetry while its effect remains, as in the poet's words:
محمد تفد نفسك كل نفس ... إذا ما خفت من شيء تبالا
(O Muḥammad, let your soul ransom every soul, whenever you fear any harm.)
i.e. لتفد. And التبال is الوبال, meaning destruction.

safi-cedvel:8-9.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive. (كأيّن) a noun of indefinite number (kināya), indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of nominative, a mubtadaʾ. (من قرية) tamyīz (specification). (عن أمر) attached to (عتت). (الفاء) conjunction. (حسابا) mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative, and likewise (عذابا)..
Clause: «كأيّن من قرية ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «عتت ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of كأيّن.
And the clause: «حاسبناها ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause عتت.
And the clause: «عذّبناها ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause عتت.
9- (الفاء) conjunction. (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) – or resumptive..
And the clause: «ذاقت ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause عذّبناها.
And the clause: «كان عاقبة أمرها خسرا» is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl, with an implied قد.

* Morphology:
(عتت): it contains an iʿlāl by deletion as in عتوا.. see verse (77) of Sūrat al-Aʿrāf.
(خسرا): a samāʿī maṣdar (heard from the Arabs) of the triliteral خسر; its wazn is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn. There are other maṣdars of the verb: خسر with fatḥa then sukūn, خسر with two ḍammas, خسار with fatḥa on the khāʾ, خسارة with fatḥa on the khāʾ, and خسران with ḍamma on the khāʾ and sukūn on the sīn..

* Rhetoric:
Majāz mursal (non-metaphorical figurative usage): in the saying of the Exalted وَكَأَيِّنْ مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ عَتَتْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّها.
The relation of this majāz is locality (maḥalliyya), from naming the place and intending what is in it.

safi-cedvel:10-12.t:
* I'rab:
(لهم) attached to (أعدّ). (الفاء) links to the apodosis of an implied condition. (أولي) a vocative, a muḍāf, accusative, its sign of accusative being the yāʾ. (الذين) a relative in the position of accusative, ʿaṭf bayān to أولي – or a badal from it. (قد) a particle of certainty. (إليكم) attached to (أنزل).
Clause: «أعدّ اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is a resumption confirming the content of what precedes.
And the clause: «اتّقوا ... » is in the position of jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e.: "if Allah has prepared punishment for whoever rebels against His command, then fear Him".
And the clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause: «أنزل اللَّه ... » has no grammatical position; it is an explanatory resumption.
11- (رسولا) a direct object of an omitted verb, i.e. "He sent a messenger" [Note: It may be a badal from (ذكرا), or an object of the maṣdar (ذكرا), or an object of an omitted verb in the sense of incitement (ighrāʾ), i.e. "Adhere to ..."]. (عليكم) attached to (يتلو). (اللام) of reason. (يخرج) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām. (من الظلمات) attached to (يخرج), and likewise (إلى النور). (الواو) resumptive..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يخرج..) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to (أنزل), or to (يتلو).
(من) a jussive-governing conditional noun in the position of nominative, a mubtadaʾ. (باللَّه) attached to (يؤمن). (يعمل) an imperfect verb, jussive, conjoined to the protasis by the wāw. (صالحا) a direct object, accusative [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, being its adjective, the direct object being implied]. (من تحتها) attached to (تجري) [Note: or attached to a ḥāl from الأنهار] with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "from beneath its trees". (خالدين) a ḥāl from the third-person pronoun in (يدخله), where the wording of (من) is observed in it. (فيها) attached to (خالدين), and likewise (أبدا), an adverb of time. (قد) a particle of certainty. (له) attached to a ḥāl from (رزقا) [Note: an adjective that has been placed before the noun it describes].
And the clause: «يتلو ... » is in the position of accusative, an adjective of (رسولا).
And the clause: «يخرج ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the clause: «آمنوا ... (the second)» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the second relative (الذين).
And the clause: «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «من يؤمن ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «يؤمن باللَّه ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) [Note: It is permissible that the khabar be the two clauses of the condition and the apodosis together].
And the clause: «يعمل ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause يؤمن.
And the clause: «يدخله ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis, not accompanied by the fāʾ.
And the clause: «تجري ... الأنهار» is in the position of accusative, an adjective of جنّات.
And the clause: «قد أحسن اللَّه ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl from the third-person pronoun in (يدخله).
12- (الواو) conjunction. (من الأرض) attached to a ḥāl from (مثلهنّ), which is conjoined to سبع سموات [Note: It is also permissible that (مثلهنّ) be a direct object of an omitted verb, i.e. "and He created their like from the earth", the conjunction then being a conjunction of clauses]. (بينهنّ) an adverb, accusative, attached to (يتنزّل). (لتعلموا) like ليخرج. (على كلّ) attached to the khabar (قدير). (الواو) conjunction. (بكل) attached to (أحاط) [Note: or attached to (علما)]. (علما) a tamyīz converted from the fāʿil, i.e.: "the knowledge of Allah has encompassed everything".
And the clause: «اللَّه الذي ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
And the clause: «خلق ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
And the clause: «يتنزّل الأمر ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl from سبع سموات, or from السموات والأرض.
And the clause: «تعلموا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-type relative (أن).
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن تعلموا.) is in the position of genitive by the lām, attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "I inform you of that".
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّ اللَّه على كلّ شيء قدير) is in the position of accusative, standing in the place of the two objects of تعلموا.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله قد أحاط..) is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the last interpreted maṣdar.
And the clause: «قد أحاط ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of أنّ.

* Rhetoric:
Explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya): in the saying of the Exalted لِيُخْرِجَ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ مِنَ الظُّلُماتِ إِلَى النُّورِ. Here He, glorified and exalted, likened disbelief to darkness, then omitted the thing likened and retained the thing likened to; and likened faith to light, again omitting the thing likened and retaining the thing likened to.
